name: ignition-lab
description: A library-free V8 engine lab with live thermodynamics and an open Blender assembly.
author: Berkay Orhan

scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests package.json tsconfig.json vercel.json .github/workflows/checks.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests package.json tsconfig.json vercel.json .github/workflows/checks.yml
scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/engine.mjs && node tests/audio.cjs && node tests/vehicle.mjs && node tests/assets.cjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm test
